description: TY2027 head of household, wages $30,000, one qualifying child. Standard deduction $24,925 → taxable income $5,075; Tax Table row $5,050–$5,100 (midpoint $5,075) → $508. CTC $2,300 limited to the $508 of tax; ACTC = min($2,300 − $508, $1,800 (§ 3.05(2)), 15% × ($30,000 − $2,500)) = $1,792. EITC (§ 3.06, one child): max $4,573, phase-out from $24,660 at 15.98%; EIC Table midpoint $30,025 → $4,573 − 15.98% × $5,365 = $3,715.67 → $3,716. Net tax $508 − $508 − $1,792 − $3,716 = −$5,508.
